ios.desc:
NexSpend is the calm, privacy-first AI expense tracker and budget app designed for effortless money management on iPhone and iPad.

Track spending, scan receipts, set smart budgets, and gain AI-powered insights — all with a beautiful, Apple-native experience. Perfect for daily expense tracking, subscription management, and confident financial decisions.

Why users love NexSpend:

• AI-Powered Expense Logging: Turn natural language notes or scanned receipts into smart categories and context in seconds. Receipt scanning makes tracking effortless.
• Smart Budget Planner: Get tailored budget recommendations and practical tips per category. Support for Income Day means your budgets align with your actual payday.
• Subscription & Bill Tracker: See recurring costs, their impact, and never miss a payment.
• Today View & Quick Add: Log expenses fast with insights before saving. Daily money notes and localized notifications keep you informed.
• Multi-Currency & Global Ready: Excellent locale and currency handling across many languages including English, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, and German.
• Beautiful & Accessible Design: Refined visuals, smooth dark mode, improved accessibility, readability, and polished transitions.

Privacy-First by Design
No data collection, on-device processing + reliable iCloud sync. No ads, no trackers. Your financial data stays yours.

NexSpend+ unlocks deeper AI insights, advanced ratings/notes, and premium features for an even calmer money experience.

Recent improvements include:
- Much faster AI insights (reduced from ~40s to ~2s)
- Receipt scanning
- Enhanced onboarding and first-run experience
- Cleaner subscription flow, promo code support, and better upgrade/trial experience
- Improved iCloud syncing and overall stability/performance
- Ongoing visual and accessibility refinements

Take control of your finances with confidence. Download NexSpend today — the smarter way to track expenses, budget, and spend mindfully.

quotes.text:
I have ADHD, and traditional budgeting never worked for me.

Seeing totals didn’t change behavior. What did help was writing down each expense and getting some form of feedback — basically someone (or something) saying “this was fine” or “this was probably unnecessary.” That pause was enough to change my next decision.

So I built a small iOS app where:

You log expenses quickly

Spending is rated and short notes are added

Over time, patterns become obvious (impulsive buys, emotional spending, etc.)

It’s not meant to shame — more like a calm mirror with metrics.
This approach helped me personally, so I’m curious whether it resonates with others.

App link:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nexspend/id6755906178

Happy to hear criticism, skepticism, or suggestions.
quotes.story_title: I built a spending app because ADHD made me need judgment, not totals
